The Buddha taught that someone who does good deeds is happy in both this life and the next life, and feels joyful when they see their own good actions

A person who does good deeds feels happy and joyful in both this present life and the next life, and can reach peaceful and happy realms
We can do good deeds by sharing and helping others and doing charity, being honest and kind, respecting our parents and teachers, and keeping a calm, peaceful mind.

Benefits in this present life: We feel happy and peaceful inside, and people around us love, trust, and respect us.
Benefits in the next life: We will be reborn in good, happy realms and have a good positive life without any troubles
